wave: DONOR RESEARCH -- deep-census Souffle's provenance-backed derivation mechanism, the fourth W3 donor for R5, and the first mechanism directly addressing R5's own named 'evidence-preserving query dependencies' goal
wave_title: After 17 consecutive code-correctness generations found progressively smaller/less-evidenced candidates, pivoted back to the W3 donor research lane (Salsa x2, datafrog, differential-dataflow already censused) to pick up souffle, one of the two W3 donors explicitly named as untouched in the differential-dataflow record's own Decision section. Souffle's `--provenance` translation strategy -- a distinct AST-to-RAM lowering pass layered onto its ordinary semi-naive evaluation -- makes a derived Datalog fact's own justification a first-class, reconstructable, on-demand-queryable artifact, a capability none of the three prior W3 donors have and one directly relevant to Atlas's own core evidence-tracking discipline extended to DERIVED (not just observed) facts.
priority_classification: semantic preservation / roadmap advancement (R5's own named goal: 'evidence-preserving query dependencies') -- real donor research advancing the W3 lane, not code correctness work, selected because the code-correctness vein this session mined extensively (17 generations) was yielding progressively smaller, squishier candidates without a clear enum/contract to validate the donor-status free-text fields against, while this donor research direction remained genuinely high-value and well-scoped.
method: Read `src/ast2ram/provenance/UnitTranslator.h` (full class declaration) and `.cpp` (the `addAuxiliaryArity`/`addProvenanceClauseSubroutines`/`makeNegationSubproofSubroutine` implementations), `src/ast2ram/provenance/ClauseTranslator.cpp` (the `@rule_num`/`@level_num` variable-assignment logic, confirming the two auxiliary columns' real meaning empirically rather than assuming from naming alone), and `src/include/souffle/SouffleInterface.h` (the public `getAuxiliaryArity()`/`getPrimaryArity()` API contract, confirming the mechanism is documented at the public interface level too, not merely an internal implementation detail). Explicitly scoped to this ONE mechanism -- not the RAM IR, interpreter, C++ synthesiser, or parser, all substantial separate census targets for a donor of this size.
key_finding: Souffle's provenance mode stores exactly two fixed, inline auxiliary columns (`rule_num`, `level_num`) as part of every derived tuple in an opted-in relation -- never a separate side-table -- and auto-generates a per-rule 'subproof' subroutine from the SAME AST the derivation rule itself was compiled from, letting any specific tuple's justification be reconstructed on demand by re-executing that one rule as a targeted existence check, recursively, with termination guaranteed because `level_num` strictly decreases at each step. This is a real, shipped, working pattern for extending Atlas's own leaf-observation evidence discipline (`Evidence`/`Provenance`/`EpistemicStatus`) to DERIVED facts -- directly relevant to R5's own roadmap text ('evidence-preserving query dependencies') and R6 (reconciliation/CensusCertificate), and complementary to (not competing with) the incremental-evaluation mechanisms already censused from Salsa/datafrog/differential-dataflow, since the provenance pattern is evaluation-strategy-agnostic.
